formula.trend_index: Weekly FanDuel value from the comparative Trends series; future dates use real month averages from the same 53-week curve.
formula.fixture_load: sum(heat_weight x tier_multiplier) for the day's fixtures
formula.daily_heat_score: 0.52 x trend_index + 0.48 x fixture_score + named-moment boost, clamped to 0..100
formula.timeslot_heat_score: 0.48 x daily_heat_score + 0.52 x slot fixture score
formula.state_activation_heat: national demand heat plus local fixture boost, minus a governance penalty only when college fixtures are restricted in that state

status_notes: Modelled heat is a planning prior, not a real fixture-feed forecast.
Fixture labels remain structural until a schedule connector replaces them.
College governance badges reduce activation heat, not underlying consumer demand.
